svg.title: Neural Arcade — Derol Chong
svg.desc: An original 2D circuit puzzle. A tiny agent tries a blocked shortcut, remembers a useful route, unlocks an exit, and replays it. This illustrative story is driven by real GitHub contribution counts, calendar cells, cache lights and activity signals; it does not represent actual reinforcement learning or measured agent performance.

g.aria-label: A small agent. A bad shortcut. A better way through.
STORE THE TURN. SKIP THE WALL.
